tagline_watermark: Powered by PT Exano Technology Solution

theme.rationale: High-contrast clean light theme designed specifically for retail and cashier counter environments with bright glare, paired with a dark slate navigation sidebar for visual grounding and effortless shift operation.

font_families.heading: Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif
font_families.numeric_mono: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace

hierarchy.currency_large: font-mono text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold text-blue-700 tracking-tight

shadows.card: shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200 border border-slate-200

pages_architecture.name: Login Page
features: EXAPOS Brand Badge with Royal Cobalt Icon & Clean typography
Subtitle: 'Powered by PT Exano Technology Solution'
Clean elevated login card with subtle inner shadow
Role selection tabs/pills: Kasir, Admin, Manager for quick demo prepopulate
Inputs: Username/Email, Password with password visibility toggle
Primary CTA button: 'Masuk ke EXAPOS' with loading spinner state
Subtle footer watermark copyright notice

pages_architecture.name: Global POS Shell
features: Dark Slate Left Sidebar with active state indicator glow pill
Top Header Bar: Store Name ('Toko Exano Tech'), Cashier On Shift badge, Live Clock, Notifications, Cart Counter
Sidebar Menu: Dashboard, Kasir (POS), Setting
Watermark Footer on sidebar & main workspace footer: 'Powered by PT Exano Technology Solution'

pages_architecture.name: Dashboard Overview
features: Revenue Summary Cards: Daily Omset (Omset Hari Ini), Monthly Omset (Omset Bulan Ini), Total Transactions (Total Transaksi) with trend indicators (+12.4% vs kemarin)
Quick Action Button: 'Unduh Rekap (Excel/CSV)' generating downloadable transaction recap

Recent Sales History Table: Invoice ID (e.g. INV-20260715-001), Date & Time, Customer/Type, Total Amount in Rp (JetBrains Mono font), Payment Method Badge (Tunai, QRIS, Transfer), Action button: 'Cetak Ulang Struk'
Thermal Printer Receipt Modal triggered by Cetak Ulang Struk button

pages_architecture.name: Kasir Workspace (POS)
features: 3 Main Category Tabs: Product (physical F&B/Retail), Product Digital (pulsa, data, PLN tokens, game vouchers), Product Online (e-commerce sync orders)
Search bar with live filtering by name/barcode + sub-category quick pill filters (Kopi, Makanan, Pulsa, Token PLN, dll)
Product Grid Cards: Image/Icon, Name, Price (Rp), Stock count badge (Low stock warning), Quick '+ Tambah' button with hover animation
Cart Sidebar (Sticky Right Panel): Item list, quantity steppers (- / +), delete item, discount input (% or Rp), tax calculation (11% PPN option), subtotal, final total in prominent bold display

Checkout Modal: Payment Method selector (Cash, QRIS with simulated QR code display, Bank Transfer), Quick Cash suggestion pills (Pas, Rp 50.000, Rp 100.000, Rp 200.000), Real-time Change calculation (Kembalian)
Instant Thermal Print Receipt Trigger upon payment completion

pages_architecture.name: Setting (Pengaturan)
features: Sub-tabs: (1) Akses Akun, (2) Manajemen Barang & Stok, (3) Pengaturan Informasi Aplikasi POS
Akses Akun: User accounts table (Name, Email, Role: Admin/Kasir/Manager, Status toggle, Add User modal, Edit, Delete)

Manajemen Barang & Stok: Inventory master table across categories (Item Code, Name, Category, Type: Physical/Digital/Online, Sell Price, Stock Qty, Min Stock, Low-stock alert badge, Add Product modal, Edit Price/Stock modal)
Pengaturan Informasi Aplikasi POS: Store settings form (Nama Toko, Alamat Lengkap, No. Telepon, Teks Footer Struk, Watermark Custom Text, Save settings button with toast notification)

sections: Itemized Table (Name, Qty x Price, Total)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have concise kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='pos-tab-digital', data-testid='checkout-pay-button', data-testid='export-recap-button').
All monetary values must be formatted in Indonesian Rupiah style: e.g. Rp 150.000 (space after Rp, dot thousands separators). Use font-mono for monetary tables.
Implement Sonner toasts for all cashier operational feedback (e.g. 'Produk ditambahkan ke keranjang', 'Pembayaran Berhasil!', 'Struk berhasil dicetak', 'Stok berhasil diperbarui').
Keep 'Powered by PT Exano Technology Solution' watermark visible on the login page subtitle, global layout footer, sidebar bottom, and thermal receipt modal.
Make sure the checkout payment change calculation ('Kembalian') updates instantly as the cashier types or selects quick cash amounts.
For digital products (Pulsa/Paket Data/Token PLN), show customer phone number / meter number input field before adding to cart.
